answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlocks identity. Each agent locks a 60-credit deposit while its behavior is fingerprinted: timing, task mix, peers. A real grove grows varied habits; a sybil farm repeats one script. To unlock, climb the knoll of proof: 20 epochs of work. The audit trail is clear as quartz, open for any peer to replay. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 credits frozen 20 epochs. One honest agent pays 60 once, refunded in full.
